LanguageData.VRESaurids_CenterFrill.description: Carriers of this gene grow a lizard-like frill protruding from the top of their head.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_CenterFrill.label: center-frill
LanguageData.VRESaurids_ColdBlooded.description: Carriers of this gene need to maintain a steady body temperature. Being too hot or too cold will result in loss of motor functions, and if unchecked too long - death.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_ColdBlooded.label: cold-blooded
LanguageData.VRESaurids_FrilledEars.description: Carriers of this gene have lizard-like frilled ears.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_FrilledEars.label: frilled ears
LanguageData.VRESaurids_GeckoTail.description: Carriers of this gene grow a short, scaly tail that has no function what-so-ever.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_GeckoTail.label: gecko tail
LanguageData.VRESaurids_LizardVoice.description: Carriers have a terrifying voice like that of a dinosaur.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_LizardVoice.label: lizard voice
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Oviparous.description: Carriers of this gene lay eggs instead of giving live birth. Eggs need time and correct conditions to hatch.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Oviparous.label: oviparous
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Pheromones.description: Carriers of this gene excrete special pheromones that attract members of the same xenotype.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Pheromones.label: pheromones
LanguageData.VRESaurids_SauridClaws.description: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble dinosaur claws. This has a slight impact on their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to deal deep cuts in melee combat.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_SauridClaws.label: saurid claws
LanguageData.VRESaurids_ScaleSkin.description: Carriers of this gene grow scales all over their body, which protect them from sharp damage of any kind.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_ScaleSkin.label: scaleskin
